name: SEO Gets
description:
For $39/mo, SEO Gets connects Claude directly to your Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 data, and allows you to create and reference annotations. Ask about performance trends, generate reports and action plans, check indexing status and errors, and query performance by page, keyword, or date range across any connected property. 

SEO Gets enriches raw GSC data with content groups, topic clusters, and brand keyword filtering, so answers reflect how you’ve actually organized your site, not just raw rows from the API. You can also compare performance across multiple connected properties in a single conversation. 

Built for SEO strategists, agencies, consultants, and in-house teams who need direct answers from their GSC and GA4 data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SEO Gets to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SEO Gets to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.seogets.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SEO Gets MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO Gets lists 23 MCP tools, including create_content_group, create_site_annotation, create_topic_cluster, create_user_tag, delete_content_group, delete_site_annotation, delete_topic_cluster, delete_user_tag, get_gsc_performance, get_indexing_overview, get_indexing_status, and get_site_performance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SEO Gets?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SEO Gets in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does SEO Gets MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO Gets requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SEO Gets is developed by SEO Gets LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
